enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn head to left. Move right arm. Pull blanket up to chin. Bend left leg. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Turn to left side. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Move left hand. Turn head to right. Pull blanket down. Turn to back. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, showering, and getting dressed for work
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs over side. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Lift toilet lid. Urinate. Flush toilet. Lower lid. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around waist. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth. Put toothbrush down. Apply deodorant. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, preparing coffee and a packed lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, bread, lettuce, tomato, ham. Close refrigerator. Take out frying pan from cupboard. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Put eggs on plate and place on table. Toast bread. Assemble sandwich. Put sandwich in container. Place container in bag. Prepare coffee. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink coffee. Clean up dishes.

Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Open door. Step out. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community programs, emails, and partner meetings
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at office. Clock in. Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Make phone calls. Attend meeting. Take notes. Discuss program coordination. Return to desk. Type report. Print document. File document.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Leave office. Walk to nearby cafe. Open door. Enter. Order food. Pay. Receive food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Throw away trash. Walk back to office. Enter office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: planning upcoming community events and meeting with volunteers
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open calendar. Review event dates. Call volunteers. Schedule meeting. Meet with volunteers. Discuss event plan. Assign tasks. Take notes. Update event plan. Send emails. Print flyers. Distribute flyers.
Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, cleaning up the dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Put down bag. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out pot. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Cook food. Stir food. Turn off stove. Serve food onto plate. Place plate on table. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clean up dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV and browsing the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Browse social media. Scroll. Like post. Comment. Put down phone. Watch TV. Get up. Get snack. Return to sofa. Sit down. Eat snack.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Pat dry. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth. Put toothbrush down. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the desk lamp and computer to review tomorrow's program schedule and read
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Turn on computer. Open schedule file. Review schedule. Make notes. Close schedule. Open e-book. Read. Turn page. Continue reading. Close e-book. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Yawn. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Remain still.
